0022600162.text: The Orlando Magic (2-3, 4th in the Southeast and 0.5 games back, 9th in the East) host the Washington Wizards (3-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East) in the Magic's 7th game of the season, with Orlando 0-2 at home and Washington's road record at 1-2. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Alex Sarr (knee soreness) and Anthony Gill (back spasms) are day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Orlando won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 136-131 win in Orlando on March 12, 2026.
